LESSON: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN KENYA

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities
Topic 3.4: Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya, part of Resources and Economic Activities in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why is wildlife important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: Learners share what they have learnt as they write an essay on the contribution of tourism to the

economy of Kenya.

● Communication and Collaboration: Learners speak clearly and effectively as they brainstorm on main tourist attractions

in Kenya.

Values:
● Unity: Learners display team spirit as they debate on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.

● Responsibility: Learners engage in tasks as they write an essay on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.
